detail.longDescription:
On behalf of my fellow Program Chairs, Henning Femmer and Dietmar Winkler, I warmly invite researchers and practitioners to submit their work to Software Quality Experience Days 2027, taking place in beautiful Zell am See, Austria, on June 23–24, 2027.

We look forward to your contributions!

Submission deadline: December 2, 2026
Notification: January 26, 2027

@seresearchers@a.gup.pe #softwareengineering #research #cfp #conference 

More information:
https://www.software-quality-days.com/en/speakers/call-for-scientific-papers
